rows.label: Noon lean
rows.title: Luke Lindenmeyer 40+ receiving yards (+110)
rows.text: Nebraska at Iowa · DraftKings. My favorite noon lean. Nebraska got him the ball underneath against Ohio State. He turned five catches into 53 yards, 31 after the catch. Against an Iowa defense allowing 78.5 rushing yards per game, those short throws give him a path to 40.

rows.title: Ohio Bobcats +3 (−105)
rows.text: Toledo at Ohio · DraftKings. Ohio has won 18 straight at home. Nick Poulos ran for 58 yards and two touchdowns last game, giving Ohio a second way to move the chains. Toledo is coming off two shutouts, so I want the full three points. I pass at +2.5.

rows.title: Oran Singleton Jr. anytime touchdown (−120)
rows.text: Tulsa at UTSA · DraftKings. Baylor Hayes threw 11 touchdown passes across three November games. Singleton caught three against Charlotte, including scores from 55 and 14 yards out. He can get there before Tulsa reaches the goal line.
